title: STDDNet: Harnessing Mamba for Video Polyp Segmentation via Spatial-aligned Temporal Modeling and Discriminative Dynamic Representation Learning
caption: Figure 2. Overview of STDDNet, which consists of a spatial-aligned temporal dependency propagation (STDP) module and a discrimina- tive dynamic feature extraction (DDFE) module. STDP takes compressed high-level features from a pretrained image backbone as input, and utilizes Mamba temporally to model temporal consistency across consecutive frames. DDFE employs Mamba spatially to extract structural feature from multi-frame inputs, complemented by a gated dynamic activation unit (GDAU) to explore frame-wise dynamic variations. Based on enhanced spatiotemporal and dynamic features, STDDNet generates refined polyp segmentation results.
